# AIMERGE

> A private program for executives, founders, and operators with ADHD-style brains. Systems built for your wiring, a room that gets it, and relief in four weeks.

AIMERGE helps high-performing people with ADHD-style attention build operating systems that work with interest-driven focus instead of against it. The program centers on dopamine-friendly systems, aimable hyperfocus, and a peer room of people who share the same wiring.
